prompt:
电商单品主图。核心任务：第一眼看清商品。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结图片受众}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{只使用用户提供的核对过的文案}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。必须保留的商品识别信息：{由根据参考图或资料总结；如无特殊要求则留空}。其余画面表现请围绕“主体清晰、商品突出、第一眼看懂商品”完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。

本次输入：【填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
E-commerce single product hero image. Core task: Clearly present the product at first glance. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Use only approved copy supplied by the user}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Mandatory product identification features: {Summarized based on reference image or data; leave blank if no special requirements}. Render the rest of the visual presentation around "clear subject, prominent product, immediately understandable at first glance". Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

Inputs: [Provide product appearance, purpose of the image, verified specifications, and approved copy].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
